title: Ask for yours · louis-agent
text: Custom agents An agent for your business, built for you. We build custom agents on this framework. Each one knows your business, works on your own systems, runs hosted and measured in rand, and every change is checked before you see it. Built start to finish in South Africa. A website with an agent A website for your business, hosted and kept running, with an agent in its corner that knows your hours, your prices and your services. It answers your customers day and night, and you change what it knows by changing a file. Every quote is made for your business, on request. Ask for a website 066 391 2470 louis-agent A custom agent Tell us what the agent should do, in your own words. Which systems it needs to reach, such as a mailbox, a spreadsheet, an accounting package or a database. And where it should run. Ask for a custom agent 066 391 2470 louis-agent What happens next A short call pins down the one job it does first. Then a working agent on made-up data, so you see it before anything goes live. Then it is yours. The guide in the corner can show you how it all works. Early access Building an agent for a .NET team? The engine and its packs are heading for NuGet. Tell us what you are building and we will show you where it stands, what is measured and what is still to come. Write to us One mail, in your own words. What the agent should do, which model you would run it on, and where it would run. Send a mail 066 391 2470 On LinkedIn Ask first The guide in the corner of every page has read the architecture, every design decision and the learning write-ups. Ask it why something is built the way it is, and it answers from the doc and names it.
